caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular tray with slightly flared sides and rounded corners. The tray is predominantly red, with the interior showing spots of wear or paint chipping in some areas. The upper inner rim and the short ends of the tray are decorated with a yellowish-green band embellished with a pattern of painted fruits, leaves, and stylized black flourishes. The longer side edges are flat and have a simple border, while the interior floor includes painted motifs, possibly stylized leaves or birds, in green, yellow, and black. The background is off-white or light beige, with a few small scattered marks, and there is no additional object or decoration around the tray. The name "Mildred Ford" is written on the lower right side of the drawing.
title: Toleware Bread Tray
